candidate.title: Booking webhook payload breaks backward compatibility by changing destinationCalendar from object/null to array
reports: packages/types/calendar.d.ts:171 — changing destinationcalendar from an object or null to an array breaks existing webhook payload consumers without versioning or compatibility handling

packages/types/calendar.d.ts:171 — the public webhook payload changes destinationcalendar from a nullable object to an array without a versioned or compatible field, breaking consumers that dereference it as an object.

packages/features/bookings/lib/handlecancelbooking.ts:251 — webhook destinationcalendar is inconsistently null (handlenewbooking) vs [] (cancel/reject/confirm/paid producers), so consumers see differing shapes per trigger (e2e bookingrejected snapshot changed null->[]).

packages/features/bookings/lib/handlenewbooking.ts:1063 — booking webhooks now replace destinationcalendar's object value with an array without a compatibility field or version, so existing subscribers that read destinationcalendar.externalid will fail for bookings with a destination calendar.

packages/types/calendar.d.ts:134 — [p1, confidence 100] destinationcalendar?: destinationcalendar[] | null; silently changes the webhook-facing calendarevent contract from an object/null to an array/null without versioning, so existing webhook consumers that read payload.destinationcalendar.externalid break on every newly emitted booking payload.

packages/features/ee/payments/api/webhook.ts:119 and packages/features/ee/payments/api/webhook.ts:229 — destinationcalendar: selecteddestinationcalendar ? [selecteddestinationcalendar] : [] passes an empty array into evt whenever neither the booking nor the user has a destination calendar, which feeds eventmanager.create(evt) at webhook.ts:243 and hits the same eventmanager.ts:119 typeerror when booking.location/evt.location is google meet.
